pairs.registryProposal: Boundary ambiguity: the golden path excludes 'an agent framework that stops its own run at a spend ceiling' (builder side), yet this is an agent PLATFORM enforcing an operator-set monthly cap across many concurrent runs it spawns itself - the pre-call 'emitting client' seat. Concurrent-admission and placement doctrine apply verbatim, but the subject's stated precondition (policy about someone else's traffic, at ingest) arguably fails. The corpus should say whether a multi-run agent platform's per-agent budget is in scope, or name the sibling subject that governs it.
